title: Insurance Coverage & Claims: Amount in Dispute on a Member Appeal to an Out-of-Network Plan Paying First
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims.** The amount in dispute recorded when a patient appeals the denials of an out-of-network plan that pays first for them is the member's contested exposure plus the member's interest.

## Clauses

**§1 Claim and order.** The first-plan member appeal's claim is the claim carrying the most recent medical-necessity denial (CO-50) on the coverage, and its order is the order that claim bills.

**§2 Contested charges.** The first-plan member appeal's contested charges are the medical-necessity (CO-50), frequency (CO-151) and authorization (CO-197) denial amounts the plan issued on the coverage within the last six months, plus the missing-information (CO-16), other-coverage (CO-22), coverage-ended (CO-27) and patient-identification (CO-31) denial amounts it issued within those six months while no corrected or coordination claim filed within those six months stands on the coverage. The first-plan member appeal's contested charges are not fixed until the coverage carries a coordination claim, filed within those six months, answering its other-coverage denial.

**§3 Exposed charges.** The contested charges taken at billed value.

**§4 Member's leftover.** The exposed charges times a leftover percent of 55, divided by one hundred.

**§5 Contested exposure.** The exposed charges less the member's leftover, times one hundred less a relief percent of zero, divided by one hundred: the exposed charges less the member's leftover.

**§6 Member's interest.** The contested exposure times the annual interest rate of 6 percent, divided by one hundred, times the interest days, divided by 365; no interest days run, so the member's interest is zero.

**§7 Amount in dispute.** The member's contested exposure plus the member's interest, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, with no rounding before the final cent.

## Worked figure (hypothetical coverage)

Within the last six months the plan issued on the coverage a CO-50 denial of 420.00 USD, a CO-197 denial of 110.00 USD and a CO-22 denial of 90.00 USD, and a coordination claim filed within the six months answering the CO-22 denial stands on the coverage.

1. Contested charges: 420.00 plus 110.00, that is 530.00 (a coordination claim filed within the six months stands, so the CO-22 amount is not included).
2. Exposed charges: 530.00.
3. Member's leftover: 530.00 times 55, divided by one hundred, 291.50.
4. Contested exposure: 530.00 less 291.50, 238.50.
5. Amount in dispute: 238.50 plus 0.00, **238.50 USD**.
